headlines.title: [단독] 모회사의 '자회사 구하기' 세제혜택 올해 말 끝난다

key_headlines.title: Current Account Surplus Hits Record High, but US Trade Surplus Narrows for First Time in 6 Years
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's 2025 current account surplus reached an all-time high of 123 billion dollars, but the bilateral surplus with the United States decreased due to tariff impacts. The trade deficit with China continued for the fourth consecutive year.

key_headlines.title: South Korea's 2026 Growth Rate Expected to Be Revised Upward from 2.6%
key_headlines.summary: Bank of Korea Governor Shin Hyun-sung indicated that this year's economic growth forecast will likely be revised upward following an upward adjustment of first-quarter GDP growth. The revision will be announced in August.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy is showing strong momentum with the KOSPI index breaking through historic levels and producer prices rising significantly. May's producer price index increased 8.5% year-over-year, reaching the highest level in 46 months, driven by high oil prices and gains in the stock market, particularly in brokerage commission fees which surged 22.2%. The Bank of Korea's governor indicated that this year's economic growth forecast will likely be revised upward from the current 2.6% projection. However, regional economic disparities are widening, with semiconductor stocks dominating gains while smaller companies struggle with negative returns despite the overall market surge.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Bank of Korea is closely monitoring whether AI will fundamentally change the country's low real growth rates and neutral interest rates. Producer price inflation has become a significant concern, with May's year-over-year increase of 8.5% marking the highest level since 2018, though oil prices showed slight monthly declines. The central bank expects the full-year growth rate to be revised upward based on improved first-quarter GDP data, with the new forecast to be announced in August. Meanwhile, the government has highlighted concerns about wealth inequality and the need to distribute semiconductor industry benefits to youth and vulnerable populations through targeted investments.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI index has surged to historic levels, breaking through the 9,300 mark for the first time and rising over 100% since the beginning of the year. However, market breadth is concerning, with only 11% of KOSPI-listed stocks participating in the rally, indicating a concentration of gains in large-cap semiconductor stocks like Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix. The KOSDAQ index has underperformed significantly, falling 3.43% on the day measured. Bond-equity hybrid ETFs have seen exceptional growth of 80% this year as investors seek diversification, while volatile trading patterns continue with daily swings exceeding 500 points influenced by international geopolitical factors and Fed policy signals.
sections.Industry & Technology: Japan has announced a comprehensive growth strategy targeting 370 trillion yen (approximately 3,500 trillion won) in public-private investment through 2040 across 17 strategic sectors including physical AI, semiconductors, drones, LNG carriers, and quantum technology. Germany's physical robot company has secured unprecedented 200 billion won in funding from Chinese investors including Tencent, CATL, and JD.com, signaling intense competition in AI infrastructure development. South Korea's government is backing domestic AI champion Purioosa AI with 800 billion won in funding through the National Growth Fund, combining direct strategic investment with policy financing. China is strengthening new energy vehicle and AI cooperation with Canada despite previous trade tensions, while Korean companies like Initech are forming strategic partnerships to accelerate AI transformation in manufacturing, finance, and public sectors.
sections.Real Estate: South Korea's real estate market shows strong momentum with 16 out of 17 provinces experiencing simultaneous price increases in both sales and lease markets. High-priced apartment auctions are accelerating in Seoul as multi-property owners rush to liquidate holdings before the expiration of capital gains tax deferral benefits, with properties over 2 billion won achieving 100% successful auction rates on first attempts. Jeonse (long-term lease) prices are expected to rise 3.6% in the second half of the year, exceeding the projected sales price increase of 1.5%, driven by reduced housing supply and reconstruction delays. Vietnam is shifting its housing policy paradigm from ownership to long-term rental as soaring property prices in major cities have pushed younger generations away from homeownership, with monthly salaries of 500,000 dong unable to match apartment prices of 4 billion dong.
sections.International Economy: The global monetary policy landscape is shifting toward a hawkish stance, with the US Federal Reserve signaling potential interest rate increases despite holding rates steady at the recent FOMC meeting. Fed Chair Kevin Walsh, Trump's appointee, emphasized inflation control 12 times during his press conference and indicated internal expectations for rate hikes within the year through the dot plot. Samsung Electronics has surpassed Bitcoin in global market capitalization to reach 12th place globally, benefiting from the broader AI-driven rally in semiconductor stocks. The US Trade Representative has launched Section 301 investigations into Germany's pharmaceutical pricing policies, threatening tariffs if unfair practices are found, while the global semiconductor supply chain continues to tighten under AI infrastructure expansion demands.
sections.AI & Economy: The global memory market is experiencing explosive growth, with 2026 projections reaching 1,500 trillion won, a 4.2-fold increase from last year's 360 trillion won, driven by massive AI infrastructure investments in North America. Meta has signed a major computing supply contract with data center operator Crusoe for 1.6 gigawatts of capacity across Texas and Missouri facilities, equivalent to powering 1.2 million households, reflecting intensifying infrastructure competition among major tech companies. Server memory demand is surging, with its share of total memory revenue expanding from 37% last year to an expected 56% this year, driven by AI model development and service enhancement needs. South Korea's government is investing 800 billion won in AI company Purioosa AI through the National Growth Fund as part of efforts to establish homegrown AI champions, combining direct investment with private capital raising.
sections.Others: South Korea's National Pension Fund performance improved significantly in 2025, pushing back the projected fund depletion date from 2065 to 2069, a four-year extension, and delaying the switch to deficit operations from 2048 to 2050. SpaceX is pursuing a 200 billion dollar corporate bond offering following its record-breaking IPO last week, continuing aggressive capital raising for space infrastructure expansion. China's state media argues that the G7 era is ending, noting that the group's share of global GDP has declined from 60% in 2005 to a significantly lower percentage, while China's global GDP share has risen from 7% to approximately 18% over the same period. The government is implementing AI-based systems for industrial accident compensation as part of public institution performance evaluations, with 15 organizations achieving excellent ratings while 7 facility directors received failing grades and 11 received warnings for safety accident mismanagement.
